title: Are you a giant?
html:
Welcome to this week's MondayMotivator.

Are you a giant? Do you make the odd mistake and trip and fall?

Successful people make mistakes, take the lesson and move on, tripping and falling their way to success. It’s impossible to not make mistakes. But by not allowing them to influence who we are, and by seeing them simply as errors we have made, we can move forward.

For example, if someone criticises your work; they are not criticising you, they are criticising your work. Don't respond instantly, distance yourself from what they are saying and have a fresh look at your work. They may be right - giving you a new, more exciting angle to work from.

So this week, be a giant and have a terrific week.

Glenn 'I might be a giant' Edley
